_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. an environment sheet of a small-town bowling alley: seen across a two-lane highway at night with a pink and blue neon sign on the roofline reading SMALL WOOD LANES, a gravel lot; and behind it a rusted chained dumpster beside a chain-link fence under a single bare bulb; an inset row showing the neon sign with progressively more letters dark; labeled SMALL WOOD LANES. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
